lancer-enhanced-nuclear-cavalier.fh.appl: Fusion Hemorrhage: damage converted to Energy, +1d6 Energy bonus damage added.
lancer-enhanced-nuclear-cavalier.setting: Nuclear Cavalier: 'If you enter the DANGER ZONE during your turn, this talent takes effect on your next attack.' Heat X (Self): 'Immediately after using this weapon or system, the user takes X Heat.' So by default (off), a shot whose own self-heat crosses you into the Danger Zone doesn't trigger Aggressive Heat Bleed / Fusion Hemorrhage until your next attack - the self-heat resolves after the attack that caused it. Enable this to trigger on that same shot instead.
